take: New Jersey announced it has placed RW Connor Brown on injured reserve, retroactive to Sept. 28, and recalled RW Stefan Noesen from Utica (AHL). Brown has played five games with two goals and a third-line role of about 13:18 a night, and going by how the coach has used his players, Cody Glass (12:07 a night) is next in line for those minutes. Noesen has three points in five games, though he has averaged 9.5 minutes. The Devils sit at 8-5-0 and have controlled 58% of the quality of chances, so the roster is changing around a team already playing well.
